1oWUBy.npc: Oh, you appear to already have one of those.

steps.player: Hello, Gilbert!

steps.npc: Hey, [player name]!

steps.player: The meadow is looking lovely!

steps.text: If the player did not complete the 2022 Pride event:

steps.npc: I know! It didn't always look like this though. It used to be dull and grey!

steps.player: Dull and grey? How did it become so colourful?

steps.npc: An adventurer came along and helped me out. We cast a magic spell using flower seeds, and it created this lovely sunburst!

steps.player: Oh, I'd have liked to have seen that spell. It sounds impressive!

steps.npc: It was! The news travelled far. I've been getting lots of visitors. Many flower traders from across the lands have paid the meadow a visit.

steps.text: If the player completed the 2022 Pride event:

steps.npc: I know! Thank you again for your help with it. It fills me with happiness to see so much colour.
I've been getting lots of visitors too. Many flower traders from across the lands have paid the meadow a visit.
I've even traded with a few for some new flower seeds with different colours!

steps.text: If the player has not yet received a flower crown:

steps.player: That's really cool. What do you do with all the flowers?

steps.npc: I make flower crowns in many different colours. I'm wearing one right now!

options.text: Can I have a flower crown?

steps.player: Sounds very colourful!

steps.npc: You're welcome to have one if you'd like, just come back and ask me, anytime!

steps.player: Thank you. I might do just that!

steps.text: If the player has already received a flower crown:

steps.player: New flower seeds? What types?

steps.npc: Well as you may have noticed, you can change the colours of the flowers on your flower crown now!
Turns out the spell we cast was more powerful than we first thought.
So powerful that it made eight new colourations, all as beautiful as the first!

steps.player: That's amazing! And all because we wanted a little splash of colour.

steps.npc: Don't underestimate the power of a little splash of colour!

steps.player: I'll make sure not too!
Anything happening around here?

steps.npc: Lots of things! It's been pretty busy. There was even a huge colourful parade with thousands of people, and they chose this meadow as the starting place!

steps.player: I know, I was there!

steps.npc: You were? I didn't see you!

steps.player: It was super crowded. I was the one in the colourful outfit.

steps.npc: The one in the colourful outfit...?

steps.player: Ah, yes, like everybody else. I forgot, we were all in colourful outfits!

steps.npc: Yes! Did you have a good time?

steps.player: I did thank you. It was really nice to see so many adventurers coming together to bring a splash of colour to Gielinor.

steps.npc: It truly was, and so many flower crowns too! I was a bit worried the large pile I'd made of them would go to waste, but in the end I almost ran out!

steps.player: Really? That's cool! What made it colourful?

steps.npc: Everyone turned up in colourful outfits, it was like a sea of rainbows.
So many flower crowns too! I was a bit worried the large pile I'd made of them would go to waste, but in the end I almost ran out!

steps.player: Sounds like a nice problem to have! Will you be making more for the next parade they do?

steps.npc: The next parade?

steps.player: Yes, I'm sure they'll do another one. If so many people turned up, it must have been a great success. Why wouldn't they want to do it again?

steps.npc: That is a good point. I'll get to making some more right away.

steps.player: Maybe it'll become a yearly thing. A chance to show off some colour, and of course your fancy flower crowns, to all of Gielinor!

steps.npc: Sounds good to me, gives me time to get lots made in advance.
Right, well I clearly have work to be getting on with. See you soon!

steps.player: See you!

options.condition: If the player has completed the 2024 Pride event

steps.player: How's the Glade coming along?

steps.npc: We are currently scouting locations for it. I have a good idea of the kind of place I'm looking for, and I hope we can find it soon. I'll let you know if we need your help.

options.text: Do you have any rainbow items I can claim?

steps.player: Do you have any rainbow items I can claim?

steps.npc: Absolutely! I have a cape, shirt, jumper, flower crown and scarf for you. Which would you like?

steps.text: the rainbow items that the player does not have

steps.npc: You should have all of the old rainbow items now!

steps.text: If the player already has a cape:
Gilbert hands you a rainbow cape.
If the player already has a shirt:
Gilbert hands you a rainbow shirt.
If the player already has a jumper:
Gilbert hands you a rainbow jumper.
If the player already has a flower crown:
Gilbert hands you a rainbow flower crown.
If the player already has a scarf:
Gilbert hands you a rainbow scarf.
